title: calluna vulgaris subf. hammondii
intro: Calluna vulgaris subf. hammondii, commonly known as the Heather, is a flowering plant that belongs to the heather family, Ericaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Calluna vulgaris subf. hammondii include its ability to stimulate the nervous system and act as a diuretic, making it useful in treating conditions like insomnia and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
